# Nana's Nest Care

> Nana's Nest Care provides overnight newborn care and infant sleep coaching
> in the Washington, DC metropolitan area (Washington, DC; Maryland, including
> Bethesda, Chevy Chase, Potomac and Montgomery County; Northern Virginia,
> including McLean, Great Falls, Arlington and Alexandria). Caregivers are Registered
> Nurses or certified Newborn Care Specialists, CPR and infant-safety
> certified, background-checked, and covered by confidentiality agreements.
> Overnight shifts are typically 9pm-6am or 10pm-6am, customized to each
> household. Phone (443) 600-0583 (call or text, Monday-Friday 9am-6pm ET),
> email nanasnestcare@gmail.com (replies within 1-2 business days),
> Instagram @nanasnestcare.

## Services

- [Newborn Night Nursing](https://nanasnestcare.com/services/newborn-night-nursing.html): RN-caliber overnight, in-home newborn care, typically birth to 12-16 weeks. Overnight feedings, soothing, diapering, sleep tracking with morning notes, light nursery tidying, feeding coordination with pediatrician or lactation guidance, and postpartum recovery support. Twins, multiples and NICU graduates. Engagements from 1-2 intensive weeks to several months, 1, 3, 5 or 7 nights a week.
- [Sleep Training & Coaching](https://nanasnestcare.com/services/sleep-training.html): Personalized, gentle sleep plans from certified pediatric sleep consultants, typically 4 months through the toddler years. Newborn sleep shaping (0-4 months), sleep training (4-18 months), toddler transitions (18 months-4 years), twins and multiples. Includes an in-depth intake and sleep assessment, a written step-by-step plan, nightly text and phone support during the first 1-2 weeks, and in-home or virtual consultations.
- [All Services](https://nanasnestcare.com/services/): Comparison of night nursing, sleep training, and the combined Newborn-to-Sleep Package (birth through independent sleep).

- [Washington, DC](https://nanasnestcare.com/areas/washington-dc.html)

## Pricing

- Rates are not published. Pricing depends on caregiver qualifications, shift length, frequency and duration. Request a personalized quote and confirm the total cost, cancellation terms and any additional charges before booking: [request availability and a quote](https://nanasnestcare.com/contact.html).
- [How much does a night nurse cost in DC, Maryland & Virginia?](https://nanasnestcare.com/blog/cost-of-a-night-nurse-dc-maryland-virginia.html): What affects the rate (credentials, hours and nights per week, single baby vs. multiples, short-term vs. ongoing) and how families budget.
